description: Create a native volume rule, then edit its execution graph to grant a second pickup only after the player receives a Dragon. Play the draft, witness both real pickups, and return to the unchanged original while retaining the two undoable edits.

required_lines: LEVELTOOL\.ROOMS: length=2100 width=1800 height=600 members=6 second_length=2700 doorway_width=500\.00 doorway_height=390\.00

required_sequences.name: An authored native action and gate run in the real level graph and survive return
patterns: SMOKE\.GRID\.PICKUP: authored arena=mod:arena_grid_level_logic provenance=original archive_sha256=[0-9a-f]{64} spawn=pad_0000 trigger=volume_pad_9999 pad=pad_0001 fixed=setup_0000 weapon=base:dragon pickup_pad=pad_0008
SMOKE\.GRID\.LOGIC: authored gate=base:dragon second=setup_0001 weapon=base:cyclone undo=2
SCENARIO\.SOURCE: compiled setup\.fields\.json '[^']*grid_level_logic[^']*'.* as 2 setup records, 1 spawns,
SMOKE\.GRID\.PICKUP: before player=0 player_room=1 pickup_room=2 has_dragon=0 separation_x=[1-9][0-9]{3,}\.[0-9]
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: event\.volume\.entered '[^']*grid_level_logic[^']*' volume=volume_pad_9999 player=0 modules=2 backend=graph\.level\.runner
SMOKE\.GRID\.LOGIC: chained grants player=0 dragon=1 cyclone=1
SMOKE\.GRID\.PICKUP: after player=0 player_room=1 pickup_room=2 has_dragon=1 separation_x=[1-9][0-9]{3,}\.[0-9] volume=volume_pad_9999
